segments.description: Park National Bank provides commercial banking, consumer banking and wealth management services to consumers and businesses in Ohio, Kentucky, North Carolina and South Carolina.
segments.evidence: Park National Bank engages in the commercial banking, consumer banking, and wealth management, including trust and investment services.

changes.text: In 2026, First Citizens Bancshares merged into Park, with First Citizens National Bank merged into Park National Bank.
changes.evidence: On February 1, 2026, First Citizens Bancshares, Inc., a Tennessee corporation ("First Citizens") merged into Park, with Park continuing as the surviving corporation.
